why_nfw_did_not_run: Five native models each consumed a 7200s optimizer cap before mond-screen hit the 43200s aggregate cap. nfw1p then stopped in 0.016s with zero gradient batches. Equivalents used were 2118 of 25000, so wall time, not the work unit, was binding.

proposed.host_assumption: this i7-8700T, one BLAS thread, current checkpoint driver
proposed.matched_pair_verification: two full samples per matched pair after the optimized member, about 30s each on this host
proposed.note: 90 minutes is about 40 gradient batches at the measured baryon rate. Baryon had already flattened near iteration 30 while the projected gradient remained far above 1e-6, so a longer cap does not by itself create stationarity.
